summary: The observations OTLP exporter also sends account limits as a bounded gauge, and the docs name the observation log as the full harness telemetry series

replay.detail: No claim is written, read or replayed differently; the exporter reads the local observation log as before.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: A node with [observations.otlp] configured also posts st_account_limit_used_percent (gauge; driver, account, window) to the collector's /v1/metrics in the same batches as the log records. A batch's cursor still moves only when every signal is accepted. Without [observations.otlp] nothing runs, as before. No claim kind, field, wire or CLI contract changes.

downtime.detail: No restart beyond the normal upgrade; no migration or backfill.

recovery.detail: No data recovery is needed. Reverting stops the gauge; the log records are unchanged.
